y-m-56-08.topic: Ukuqhathanisa idatha: amanani nezilinganiso, nolwazi oludingekayo ukuqhathanisa
y-m-56-08.goal: Wazi ukuthi inani labafundi ababusebenzisile alanele ukuqhathanisa ukuthi iklasi ngalinye libusebenzise kangakanani, khomba ulwazi oludingekayo ekuqhathaniseni (inani eliphelele labafundi), futhi wakhe amacala afanelana nesimo uma kunikezwa ulwazi olusha.
y-m-56-08.material: Inyanga edlule, abafundi abangu-12 beKlasi A nabafundi abangu-9 beKlasi B basebenzise umtapo wezincwadi weklasi wesikole. Asikazi inani eliphelele labafundi eklasini ngalinye. Lapha, 'iklasi elisebenzise kakhulu' lisho 'iklasi lapho isilinganiso sabafundi abasebenzise umtapo kubafundi bonke beklasi sikhulu'. Khumbula ukuthi iklasi ngalinye lingaba nenani elihlukile labafundi.

y-m-56-08.s.s1.o.d: Uma singazi izamu, asikwazi ukusho ukuthi yiliphi iklasi eliphezulu
y-m-56-08.s.s1.r.d: Lesi sahlulelo sithi isilinganiso singingxenye uma iqhathaniswa nokuphelele, ngakho awukwazi ukuqhathanisa ngaphandle kokwazi okuphelele.

y-m-56-03.topic: Inani elincane lomsebenzi: umphumela ushintsha kanjani ngesifunda (ububanzi bika-x)
y-m-56-03.goal: Yazi ukuthi ngisho nangesibalo esifanayo, inani elincane lingahlala linjalo, lishintshe, noma lingabikho nhlobo kuye ngobubanzi bika-x (isifunda), bese wakha ububanzi obuhambisana nombandela.
y-m-56-03.material: Cabanga ngomsebenzi f(x) = x² − 4x + 5. (x² ifundwa 'x squared'.) Amanani ambalwa angu-f(0) = 5, f(1) = 2, f(2) = 1, f(3) = 2, f(4) = 5. Uma kungekho bubanzi bika-x obunikeziwe, x ingaba yinoma iyiphi inombolo yangempela. Ake sishintshe ububanzi bika-x sibone ukuthi kwenzekani enanini elincane (elincane kakhulu) lika-f.

y-m-56-02.title: Isibalo segrafu ehanjisiwe saphosa kuphi?
y-m-56-02.topic: Ukuhumushela igrafu: ukuhlola isibalo segrafu ehanjisiwe
y-m-56-02.goal: Lapho ubhala isibalo ngemva kokuhamba kwegrafu, ungathembeli kuphela emthethweni ogcinwe engqondweni wesiqondiso nophawu; hlola isibalo ngephoyinti igrafu ehanjisiwe okumele idlule kulo, futhi ubone ukuthi ukuhamba okungaphezu kokukodwa kungafanela isimo.
y-m-56-02.material: Igrafu yomsebenzi y = |x| inesimo se-'V' ene-vertex ku-(0, 0), lapho y = 1 kokubili lapho x = 1 nalapho x = −1. (|x| ifundwa 'inani eliphelele lika-x'.) UMinjae ubhale isixazululo sokuthola isibalo segrafu etholwe ngokuhambisa le grafu u-2 ngakwesokudla (ohlangothini oluphozithivu lwe-x-axis).
y-m-56-02.thinking.0: Hlola umugqa ngamunye wesixazululo ukuhambisana nomugqa ongaphambi kwawo
y-m-56-02.thinking.2: Thola ukuthi ukuhamba okungaphezu kokukodwa kungafanela isimo
y-m-56-02.prereq.0: Uphawu lwenani eliphelele nesimo segrafu ka-y = |x| (ukuhlola kwebanga lesikole esiphakathi)
y-m-56-02.prereq.1: Ukufaka inani le-x esibalweni somsebenzi ukuthola u-y
y-m-56-02.s.s1.hint.0: Faka iphoyinti (2, 0) elitholwe emugqeni 2 ngqo esibalweni somugqa 3.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa umugqa ngamunye nomugqa ongaphambi kwawo eyodwa ngesikhathi.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.0: Isibalo segrafu yokuqala ngu-y = |x|, futhi i-vertex yayo ngu-(0, 0).
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.1: Uma ihanjiswe ngo-2 ngakwesokudla, i-vertex ihamba iye ku-(2, 0).
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.2: Yahanjiswa ngo-+2 ohlangothini lwe-x, ngakho shintsha u-x esibalweni ngo-x + 2 bese ubhala u-y = |x + 2|.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.explain: Indawo yokuqala ehamba ngephutha ngumugqa 3. Umugqa 2 uthi i-vertex iba ngu-(2, 0), kodwa uma ufaka u-x = 2 esibalweni u-y = |x + 2| emugqeni 3, uthola u-y = 4, ngakho akudluli ku-(2, 0). Umugqa 4 uthwala nje isibalo esivela emugqeni 3, ngakho nawo uhamba ngephutha.

y-m-56-02.s.s2.hint.1: Faka ukuqondanisa kwalelo phoyinti esibalweni bese uhlola ukuthi ukulingana kuyagcina yini.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.a: Faka i-vertex ehanjisiwe (2, 0) esibalweni esisha u-y = |x + 2|
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.a: Uhlole ukuthi iphoyinti igrafu ehanjisiwe okumele idlule kulo linelisa isibalo esisha yini.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.b: Faka u-x = 0 esibalweni esisha u-y = |x + 2| bese ubona ukuthi y = 2 yini
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.b: Uhlole kuphela ukuthi ukubala kusebenza ngaphakathi kwesibalo esisha. Awuzange uqhathanise nephoyinti osuvele uliyazi egrafwini ehanjisiwe.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.c: Faka u-x = 2 esibalweni sokuqala u-y = |x| bese ubona ukuthi y = 2 yini
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.c: Uhlole isibalo esivela ngaphambi kokuhanjiswa. Lokhu kubala akukwazi ukukutshela ukuthi isibalo ngemva kokuhanjiswa sihambisana negrafu ehanjisiwe yini.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.d: Yamukela 'yahanjiswa ngo-+2, ngakho bhala +2 nasesibalweni' njengokulungile bese uqhubeka
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.d: Wethembe umthetho wokuthi uphawu lwesiqondiso nophawu esibalweni kuyafana. Ukuthi umthetho ulungile kumele kuhlolwe ngephoyinti.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.explain: Uma ufaka iphoyinti (2, 0), igrafu ehanjisiwe okumele idlule kulo, esibalweni esisha, uthola u-y = 4, okukhombisa iphutha. Isibalo esidala (a) noma ukubala ngaphakathi kwesibalo esisha (b) akukwazi ukukutshela ukuthi 'kuhambisana negrafu ehanjisiwe'.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.prompt: Kulokhu, kusuka ezibalweni zesimo u-y = |x − h| + 1, yenza esinye esigrafu salo sidlula ephoyintini (0, 4). Thola amanani amabili ahlukene ka-h. (|x − h| ifundwa 'ivelu eliphelele lika-x kususwe h'.)
y-m-56-02.s.s3.hint.0: Faka u-x = 0, y = 4 esibalweni bese wenza isibalo ku-h.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.hint.1: Zama inani elihle nelingemuhle lika-h bese uhlola ukuthi y iba ngu-4 yini.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.ok.c1: Uma x = 0, y = 4, ngakho kudlula ephoyintini (0, 4).
y-m-56-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Uma ufaka u-x = 0, y ayiba ngu-4. Faka u-x = 0 esibalweni bese uhlola ku-h.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.explain: Ukufaka u-x = 0, y = 4 kunika |h| + 1 = 4, okungukuthi, |h| = 3, ngakho h = 3 noma h = −3. Nge-h = 3 igrafu ihanjiswe ngo-3 ngakwesokudla, futhi nge-h = −3 ihanjiswe ngo-3 ngakwesobunxele, futhi zombili zikhushulelwe phezulu ngo-1.

y-m-56-01.title: Ingabe lokhu kuhambisana kungabizwa ngokuthi umsebenzi?
y-m-56-01.topic: Incazelo yomsebenzi: ukuhambisana lapho okufakwayo ngakunye kunikeza umphumela owodwa ncamashi
y-m-56-01.goal: Hlola ukuhambisana ngakunye ngesimo sokuthi okufakwayo ngakunye kunikeza umphumela owodwa ncamashi, hlunga ukuthi yiziphi imisebenzi, lungisa ukuhambisana okungewona umsebenzi ukuze kube yiwo, bese wakha umsebenzi owanelisa isimo ebangeni lawo.
y-m-56-01.material:
Ekilasini labafundi abangu-28, umfundi ngamunye unenombolo eyodwa yokuhambela kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-28, futhi wonke umfundi unosuku olulodwa ncamashi lokuzalwa (ungawanaki iminyaka yokweqa). Ukuhambisana lapho okufakwayo ngakunye kunikeza umphumela owodwa ncamashi kubizwa 'umsebenzi'. Lapha, umphumela usho inombolo eyodwa (noma inombolo eyodwa yokuhambela); imiphumela eminingana ayibalwa njengebhandeli elilodwa. Kunokuhambisana okune ngezansi.
(가) inombolo yokuhambela → inyanga lowo mfundi azalwa ngayo (Januwari kuya kuDisemba)
(나) inyanga yokuzalwa (Januwari kuya kuDisemba) → izinombolo zokuhambela zabafundi abazalwa kuleyo nyanga
(다) inombolo yemvelo → inani lezihlukanisi zaleyo nombolo
(라) inombolo yemvelo → izinombolo ezingezihlukanisi zaleyo nombolo

y-m-56-01.thinking.1: Chaza ngezinombolo ezithile ukuthi kungani ukuhambisana kungeyona umsebenzi
y-m-56-01.thinking.2: Yakha imisebenzi ehlukile eneliseyo isimo ebangeni

y-m-56-01.prereq.2: Lo msebenzi ubonisa kuphela izinga lobunzima nolwesekelo H1 lweqembu elikhiqiziwe; ayisho ukuthi isifundo sinikezwa ibanga elithile. Ingcabango: izisekelo zemisebenzi yesikole esiphakathi, ijiyomethri nedatha sezivele zifundiwe.

y-m-56-01.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo sithi okufakwayo ngakunye (inombolo yokuhambela) kunikeza inyanga eyodwa ncamashi yokuzalwa. Uhlolile isimo sencazelo.
y-m-56-01.s.s1.r.b: Uma unqume 'kunabafundi, ngakho inombolo iyanqunywa', hlola ukuthi kukhona yini inyanga enabafundi abaningana abazalwe kuyo, noma engenamfundi nhlobo.
y-m-56-01.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sithi 'inani' lezihlukanisi liyinombolo eyodwa kunombolo yemvelo ngayinye.
y-m-56-01.s.s1.r.d: Inombolo ingaba nezihlukanisi eziningana. Hlola ngenombolo efana no-6 ukuthi isimo 'umphumela owodwa kokufakwayo ngakunye' sibamba yini.

Ku-(다), inombolo ngayinye inenani elilodwa ncamashi lezihlukanisi. Ku-(나), abafundi abangu-28 bazalwa ezinyangeni eziyi-12, ngakho kumele kube nenyanga enabafundi ababili noma ngaphezulu abazalwe kuyo, futhi inombolo ayinqunywa njengenye (kungaba khona nenyanga engenamfundi). Ku-(라), ezinye izinombolo ezifana no-6 zinezihlukanisi eziningana, ngakho umphumela awunqunywa njengowodwa.

y-m-56-04.title: Iphoyinti C kufanele liye kuphi ukwenza unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo?
y-m-56-04.topic: Ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili endizeni yokuqondanisa nonxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo
y-m-56-04.goal: Qhathanisa amabanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili usebenzisa ukuqondanisa, yakha amaphoyinti enza unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo ngezindlela eziningana ezihlukile, bese ukhetha icala elingesilo unxantathu (konke kulayini oyedwa).
y-m-56-04.material: Endizeni yokuqondanisa kukhona u-A(0, 0) no-B(4, 0). Ufuna ukukhetha iphoyinti C(x, y) lapho ukuqondanisa kwe-x nokwe-y kokubili kuyizinombolo eziphelele bese wenza unxantathu ABC. Isikwele sebanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili singu-(umehluko ovundlile) squared + (umehluko oqondile) squared. Ngakho AB² = 16, AC² = x² + y², BC² = (x − 4)² + y². (Ukuqhathanisa izikwele zobude kunika umphumela ofanayo nokuqhathanisa ubude ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izimpande zesikwele.)

y-m-56-04.s.s1.explain: Unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo udinga nje noma yiziphi izinhlangothi ezimbili kwezintathu zibe nobude obufanayo. Izinhlangothi ezintathu azidingeki zonke zilingane (leso simo singunxantathu olinganayo). Ngakho AB = AC, AC = BC no-AB = BC konke kuyizimo zonxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.prompt: Khetha iphoyinti C(x, y) lapho x no-y kokubili kuyizinombolo eziphelele, y ≠ 0 (ngoba kumele kube unxantathu), |x| ≤ 10 no-|y| ≤ 10, ukuze unxantathu ABC abe unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo. Thola amaphoyinti amane ahlukene C.

y-m-56-04.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha iphoyinti elilodwa, bala izikwele zobude bezinhlangothi ezintathu, bese uhlola ukuthi ayikho yazo elingana yini.

y-m-56-04.s.s2.explain: Iphoyinti elinelise x = 2 (isibonelo (2, 1), (2, −3)) linika AC = BC. Ku-(0, 4) no-(0, −4), AC² = 16 = AB², futhi ku-(4, 4) no-(4, −4), BC² = 16 = AB². Uma y = 0, khona-ke A, B no-C kusekulayini oyedwa, ngakho akusona unxantathu.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Hlanganisa amaphoyinti owenzile namafanayo, futhi kuqembu ngalinye bhala ukuthi yiziphi izinhlangothi ezimbili ezinobude obufanayo. Bhala nokuthi kungani ushiye amaphoyinti ane-y = 0.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala ukuqondanisa kwe-x kwamaphoyinti akho eceleni komunye.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Chaza ngamazwi, ngaphandle kwesithombe, ukuthi A, B no-C babekwa kuphi uma y = 0.

y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uchaze, usebenzisa izindawo zamaphoyinti, ukuthi kungani akusona unxantathu uma y = 0?
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Iphoyinti elinelise x = 2 lingebanga elifanayo no-A no-B, ngakho AC = BC. (0,4) noma (4,4) asebangeni elingu-4, ubude obufanayo no-AB, ngakho AB = AC noma AB = BC. Uma y = 0 amaphoyinti amathathu asekulayini oyedwa ngakho akukho unxantathu, ngakho ngishiye lawo.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma ukuqondanisa kwe-x kuka-C kungu-2, kungaphezulu kwephakathi lika-A no-B, ngakho AC no-BC bayafana, futhi uma kuyiphoyinti elingebanga elingu-4 kusuka ku-origin noma ku-B, lilingana no-AB. Uma y ingu-0, A, B no-C basekulayini oyedwa, ngakho abenzi unxantathu.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ichazwe ngamazwi, kodwa ukuhlanganiswa ezinhlotsheni kucacile.

y-m-56-05.title: Ukuthola ilayini elihlangana kuphela ku-(1, 3)
y-m-56-05.topic: Indawo yamalayini amabili: ukuhlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela
y-m-56-05.goal: Yazi ukuthi ukuthi amalayini amabili ahlangana yini akunakunqunywa ngeziphumo zokuzama amanani ambalwa kuphela, hlukanisa umbandela wokuhlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela (ama-slope ahlukile) nesimo lapho amalayini ewelana, bese wakha wena ilayini elinjalo.
y-m-56-05.material: Ilayini L ngu-y = 2x + 1. Iphoyinti (1, 3) lisekulayini (ukufaka u-x = 1 kunika u-y = 3). Manje ufuna ukukhetha elinye ilayini M lesimo u-y = mx + n (m no-n kuyizinombolo eziphelele). Qala ngokubheka ukuthi yiyiphi indlela yokuhlulela ukuthi amalayini amabili ahlangana yini ethembekile, bese wakha ilayini M elihlangana no-L kuphela ku-(1, 3). Cabanga ngelayini njengelaqhubeka ngokungapheli ezinhlangothini zombili.
y-m-56-05.thinking.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi izindlela ezahlukene zokwahlulela zivumelekile kangakanani
y-m-56-05.thinking.1: Yakha amalayini amaningana anelisa imibandela (iphoyinti elidlula kulo, i-slope)
y-m-56-05.thinking.2: Khetha icala lokuwelana usebenzisa isibonelo esiphikisayo
y-m-56-05.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-slope m kugrafu yomsebenzi olayini u-y = mx + n (izinga lesikole sasemaphakathi)
y-m-56-05.prereq.1: Ukufaka ukuqondanisa kwephoyinti esibalweni ukuhlola ukuthi ilayini lidlula kulo yini
y-m-56-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izindlela ezikuvumela ukuthi uphethe ngokuthi ilayini u-y = 2x + 1 nelayini u-y = 2x + 5 'awahlangani'.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-x ofanayo ezibalweni zombili bese, kumanani ambalwa ka-x, ubhala ukuthi umehluko wamanani ka-y uziphatha kanjani.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi umphumela ungahluka yini ku-x ongazange wahlolwe, kanye neqiniso lokuthi ilayini liqhubeka ngokungapheli.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.a: Qhathanisa ama-slope ezibalo ezimbili bese uhlola ukuthi alingana futhi ama-y-intercept ahlukile
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sahlulelo sisebenzisa i-slope ne-y-intercept ukubona ukuthi amalayini amabili alele kude komunye nomunye yini.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.b: Faka u-x = 1, 2, 3, 4 bese uhlola ukuthi amanani amabili ka-y awaze alingane
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.b: Uhlole kuphela amanani ambalwa ka-x. Cabanga ukuthi kusekhona ithuba lokuthi bahlangane ku-x ongazange wahlolwe (idesimali, inombolo enkulu, njll.).
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.c: Dweba amalayini amabili ephepheni, futhi uma engabonakali ehlangana, nquma ukuthi awahlangani
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.c: Angahlangana ngaphandle kwengxenye oyidwebile. Hlola ukuthi ucabangele yini ukuthi ilayini liqhubeka ngokungapheli.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.d: Hlola ukuthi isibalo 2x + 1 = 2x + 5, esenziwe ngokumisa izibalo ezimbili zilingane, singaxazululwa yini
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.d: Lesi sahlulelo sithi uma kunephoyinti lokuhlangana, kumele kube khona u-x lapho u-y wezibalo ezimbili elingana khona.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.explain: Uma ama-slope alingana futhi ama-y-intercept ahlukile, umehluko wamanani amabili ka-y ungu-4 oqhubekayo kuwo wonke u-x, ngakho amalayini awahlangani. Isibalo esenziwe ngokuzimisa zilingane asikwazi ukuxazululwa yinoma yimuphi u-x, okunika isiphetho esifanayo. Ukuzama kuphela amanani ambalwa ka-x noma ukudweba ingxenye yamalayini kushiya izindawo ongazange uzihlole, ngakho akukwazi ukuqinisekisa 'awahlangani' (ingasetshenziswa ukuthola isibonelo esiphikisayo esikhombisa ukuthi bahlangana).
y-m-56-05.s.s2.prompt: Manje khetha umugqa u-M: y = mx + n (u-m no-n bayizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku--9 kuya ku-9) ukuze uhlangane no-L (y = 2x + 1) ephoyintini u-(1, 3) kuphela. Thola amapheya amathathu ahlukile u-(m, n).
y-m-56-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka iphoyinti u-(1, 3) ku-y = mx + n futhi wenze ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-m no-n.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-2 ku-m futhi ubheke ukuthi kwenzekani ku-M no-L.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.ok.c1: U-m no-n bayizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku--9 kuya ku-9.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.fail.c1: U-m no-n kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku--9 kuya ku-9.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Uma ufaka u-x = 1, u-y akabi ngu-3. Hlola ukuthi u-M udlula ku-(1, 3) yini.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Ukuthambeka kuhlukile, ngakho bahlangana ephoyintini elilodwa kuphela, u-(1, 3).
y-m-56-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Uma ukuthambeka kungu-2, u-M odlula ku-(1, 3) uhlangana ngokuphelele no-L, ngakho imigqa ayihlangani ephoyintini elilodwa kuphela.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.explain: Ukuze udlule ku-(1, 3), u-m + n = 3. Kodwa uma u-m = 2, bese u-n = 1, ngakho u-M uba ngumugqa ofanayo no-L futhi bahlangana emaphoyintini angenamkhawulo. Ngakho amapheya u-(m, n) kuphela anou-m ≠ 2 ahlangana ephoyintini elilodwa kuphela. Isibonelo: (0, 3), (1, 2), (−1, 4), (5, −2).
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala ukuthi kungani u-m = 2 evinjelwe, futhi usho, ngesimo esinamathiselwe, ukuthi u-'umugqa u-M odlula ku-(1, 3) uhlala uhlangana no-L ephoyintini elilodwa kuphela' uyiqiniso njalo yini.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Faka u-m = 2 ku-m + n = 3 ukuthola u-n, futhi uqhathanise isibalo salowo mugqa no-L.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi imigqa emibili enokuthambeka okuhlukile kumele ihlangane kwenye indawo yini.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Uhlole ngesibalo esithile ukuthi umugqa u-M uba yini uma u-m = 2?
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Uphendule u-'uhlala eyiqiniso' ngokunamathisela isimo (uma ukuthambeka kuhlukile)?
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ucabange nangecala lapho ukuthambeka kufana kodwa iphoyinti elidlula kulo lihlukile (abahlangani)?
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma u-m=2, ukuthambeka kuyafana, ngakho umugqa odlula ku-(1,3) uba ngu-y=2x+1 futhi uhlangana no-L. Khona-ke imigqa ihlangana emaphoyintini angenamkhawulo, hhayi elilodwa kuphela. Ngakho ukuthambeka akumele kube ngu-2 ukuze bahlangane ephoyintini elilodwa kuphela.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Noma yimuphi umugqa odlula ku-(1,3) onokuthambeka okuhlukile kwalokho luka-L uhlangana nawo ephoyintini elilodwa kuphela. Uma ukuthambeka kungu-2, okufana nokuka-L, ungu-L uqobo, ngakho akusebenzi.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.model.2: Uma u-m=2, bese u-n=1 futhi uba ngumugqa ofanayo no-L, ngakho bahlangana emaphoyintini angenamkhawulo. Bahlangana ephoyintini elilodwa kuphela uma ukuthambeka kungesiyo u-2.
